Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial analysis by assuming that "Anthemius of Italy" implies the father was from the modern country of Italy. Anthemius was a Western Roman Emperor whose rule was centered in Ravenna, and his family origins are historically traced to Africa (specifically Carthage, modern-day Tunisia), not Italy. The Planner prematurely concluded the answer was "Italy" based on the title "of Italy" rather than verifying the actual birthplace or origin of the historical figure, leading to an incorrect final answer.
